notes: Independent re-derivation for westwing.it (Italian market), not copied from any other Westwing market file. Fetched IT's own sitemap-categories.xml (593 URLs) and searched it exhaustively for pet-related Italian terms (animali, cane/cani, gatto/gatti, ciotola, cuccia, guinzaglio, museruola, pettorina, sabbietta, lettiera, trasportino, gabbia, recinto, amaca, casetta, kennel/crate, collare) plus generic 'pet' -- only ONE genuine pet category page exists: /accessori-animali/ (all other 'pet' substring hits were false positives, e.g. 'tappeti' containing 'pet', 'piccoli-elettrodomestici' containing 'domestic'). Fetched that page directly: title 'Accessori per animali domestici - Per cani e gatti | Westwing', embedded Algolia/collection JSON gives its own English breadcrumb as 'Home accessories > Pet supplies' (Italian rendered breadcrumb 'Accessori casa > Accessori per animali'), and sampled product titles confirm it's genuinely pet-specific: ciotole/ciotoline per animali (pet bowls), tappetino per ciotola (bowl mat), cuccia per animali (pet bed/house), coperta/copertina per animali (pet blanket), cuscino per animali (pet cushion), collare per animali fatto a mano (handmade pet collar). Also found a 'Idee regalo > Regali per animali domestici' (Gift ideas > Pet gifts) breadcrumb in the same embedded JSON referencing the identical product set under a gift-guide facet, not a separate PLP URL (no matching sitemap entry) -- excluded per the brief's Navigation/marketing-page rule (Gifts/Gift Guides are never a category), same underlying listing as accessori-animali so no duplicate row. Qty verified via the page's own rendered '154 Prodotti' text, appearing identically at two independent DOM locations (sort/filter-bar label and mobile filter-panel label) in a single fetch, matching the exact same dual-location verification method used and validated in the prior Home-Decor pass on this same host. No pet-food/consumable or medical/veterinary categories found on this site.
